overview.title: Program Overview
overview.description: PCI's Hybrid Dental Assistant program combines flexible online coursework with in-person lab exercises and an off-site externship to prepare students to assist dentists, perform x-rays, handle clinical and administrative duties, and sit for the Registered Dental Assistant exam in Texas.

items.title: Dental Software & Administrative Tasks
items.description: Scheduling, patient coordination and use of dental office software.

items.title: Instrument Identification and Materials Prep
items.description: Recognizing and preparing dental instruments and materials for procedures.

faq.question: How long does the Hybrid Dental Assistant program take to complete?
faq.answer: The program can be completed in as little as 9 months.

faq.question: Where is the Dental Assistant training offered?
faq.answer: Dental Assistant training is offered at PCI Health Training Centerâ€™s Richardson campus (Northeast Dallas).

faq.question: Does the program include hands-on training and externship?
faq.answer: Yes. The hybrid program includes in-person lab exercises and an off-site externship at a dental office.

faq.question: What careers can this program prepare me for?
faq.answer: The program prepares students for roles such as Dental Assistant, Dental Hygienist Assistant, and Dental Receptionist.
